title: Fix cannotCalculateChanges mapping in BackendChangesError
description:
The From<BackendChangesError<E>> for JmapError impl maps TooManyChanges { limit: 0 } to tooManyChanges with limit=0 instead of cannotCalculateChanges (RFC 8620 §5.6). PLAN.md line 167 documents the intended convention: limit=0 signals 'cannot calculate'. A backend that cannot support queryChanges has no correct way to signal this today.

Two tasks:
1. Fix the From impl: TooManyChanges { limit: 0 } → JmapError::cannot_calculate_changes(); TooManyChanges { limit > 0 } → too_many_changes_with_limit(limit).
2. Add a test: backend returns TooManyChanges { limit: 0 } → queryChanges response is cannotCalculateChanges error (PLAN.md line 440).
